text:
Ava: ok serious question: who keeps swapping my labeled yogurt with unlabeled ones in the office fridge? :scream_cat:
Leo: Not me. But I did bring extra granola this morning :bread:
Sofia: I saw someone hovering near the 3rd shelf yesterday... suspect timeline: 11:47am
Priya: Confession: i may have eaten a 'vanilla' that looked like yogurt but was mayo-country dip. sorry? :grimacing:
Nora: @Priya that's a felony in my book. :laughing:
Ava: not mayo pls. mine has `AVAS-YOG` sticker on top.
fridge-bot: Reminder: label perishable items with name and date. :label:
Leo: poll: should we get a mini lockbox for "Ava's yogurt"? :lock:
Ava: poll results so far -> yes: 2, no: 1 :thumbsup: :shrug:
Sofia: Also unrelated but kudos to @Nora for rescuing the (very) dead ficus and bringing it back to life 🌿 :tada:
Nora: thank you!! I used water + gentle guilt. 10/10 method.
Ava: ok mystery mostly solved. Whoever swapped them, please leave a note or a snack. :pleading_face:
Priya: I'll replace the yogurt and add a cookie to atone :cookie:
Leo: cookies for apologies = company policy.
Ava: cookie accepted. thread closed. :lock_with_ink_pen:
